# Runtime dependency

`model_workers.py` is the application's existing catalogue/HTTP helper, copied
from its former sibling `agent-system/skills/model-workers/scripts/` location.
Its Python dependencies are standard-library modules. This copy contains code,
not the user's model-workers skill, local credentials or runtime records.

Source hashes and origin commit are recorded outside the public export in the
local separation evidence. Confirm source licensing before public distribution.
